title: Parallel review rounds: cancel the sibling on stop, per-role activity, name every lost role, keep both owner questions

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: S117 later notes (2026-10-26): the reviewer and UI pass now run in parallel. (1) When one stops the slice, the sibling round is not cancelled. (2) The activity ring is shared; parallel rounds need one per role. (3) A lost pause names only one lost role. (4) When one role paused first, the sibling's owner question is dropped. (5) planRun now errors when relay-roles show fails; plan without a ui role instead.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Re-anchor from the code after S117. Tests first with the engine harness fakes.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: go test -race ./internal/engine ./internal/daemon; go vet; gofmt -l; slicer check; adj lint.
